k: english idiom once in blue moon
a: Once in a blue moon means very rarely.
Bite the bullet means face something difficult.
Spill the beans means reveal a secret.
Hit the nail on the head means be exactly right.
Under pressure means stressed by demands.
I'm afraid I must decline is a polite refusal.
Could you please share this by Friday? is a clear ask.
I wanted to flag a blocker that needs input is a calm escalation.
To confirm, we will... restates the plan.
End with the next action and owner.
